privacy.ai_training_note: The Einstein Trust Layer enforces a Zero Data Retention agreement with external LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI/Azure OpenAI): prompts and generated responses are not stored by the model provider and are not used to train the third-party LLMs. Per Salesforce documentation/Trailhead, customer data sent to the LLM is deleted after the response is returned, and 'no customer data will be used to train the Large Language Models.' Salesforce's own models are trained on Salesforce-curated data, not on customer data by default. Note: in the broader Salesforce CRM platform, some predictive Einstein features can be configured to use a customer's own org data to build models for that same customer only (tenant-scoped), which is distinct from cross-customer/foundation-model training.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region. Hyperforce supports data residency in selected regions (US, EU, APAC, etc.); Einstein generative features route through the Trust Layer with regional model hosting options.

security.value: HackerOne (launched 2015; over $18.9M paid across ~30,600 reported vulnerabilities). Public responsible-disclosure policy on HackerOne; private/invite-only paid program.

security.name: Responsible disclosure
security.value: Documented Responsible Disclosure / Report a Concern process linked from the security site

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Third-party penetration testing and external security assessments performed; results referenced under 'External Security Assessments' on the compliance portal

security.name: Encryption
security.value: TLS in-flight encryption; Einstein Trust Layer applies data masking and secure data retrieval; Salesforce Shield offers Platform Encryption (encryption at rest) and event monitoring

security.name: Einstein Trust Layer guardrails
security.value: Data masking (PII), toxicity/prompt-injection defense, audit trail, zero data retention with external LLMs, secure data retrieval respecting org permissions

products.name: Einstein Trust Layer
products.data_scope: Intercepts prompts/responses for generative AI; enforces zero data retention with external LLMs, data masking, audit logging. No customer data used to train third-party models.
products.notes: Foundation of Salesforce's trusted-AI posture; governs all Einstein generative features.

products.name: Einstein Generative AI / Einstein Copilot / Agentforce
products.data_scope: Grounds responses in customer CRM data via secure retrieval; routes through Trust Layer; tenant-isolated; zero retention at external LLM.
products.notes: Enterprise licensing; data stays within customer trust boundary.

products.name: Einstein Predictions / Discovery / Next Best Action (predictive AI)
products.data_scope: Builds predictive models from a customer's OWN org data, scoped to that single tenant. This is tenant-local model building, not cross-customer or foundation-model training.
products.notes: Customers configure/opt into these models; data does not leave the tenant or train shared models.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise subscription / per-user add-on (Einstein and Agentforce licensed on top of Salesforce platform editions; usage/consumption-based for some generative features). No free consumer tier.
compare.data_residency: Yes - regional data residency via Hyperforce (US, EU, APAC, and others); model hosting region options for generative AI.

flags: Vendor homepage (salesforce.com/einstein) returned Access Denied in raw capture, but trust/security/compliance portals were fully accessible and corroborated by independent sources.

Some help.salesforce.com doc pages returned error/403 to automated fetch; training/zero-retention policy confirmed via Salesforce Trailhead and corroborating secondary sources rather than a single verbatim doc quote.

Nuance: predictive (non-generative) Einstein features can use a customer's own org data to build tenant-scoped models. This is not cross-customer training and is opt-in, but should be represented accurately so it is not confused with 'no AI on my data at all.'
